title: Battle of Żarnów
summary: The English Wikipedia article "Battle of Żarnów", at revision 1370603174, opens: "The Battle of Żarnów was fought on September 16, 1655, between the forces of the Polish–Lithuanian Commonwealth, commanded by John II Casimir and the forces of the Swedish Empire, commanded by Charles X Gustav. The result ended with a Swedish victory." That is the article's account and not yet this atlas's; nobody has read this record, and review.html is where somebody does. Wikidata item Q2615519, imported by tools/import/wikidata.mjs. The item's own description reads "1655 battle of the Second Northern War; Swedish victory". Everything here is copied from the item's own fields and nothing in it is this atlas's account of the thing: that is still to be written, and review.html is where somebody writes it.
